'''''Myrcianthes''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the [[Myrtus|myrtle]] family, [[Myrtaceae]], described as a genus in 1856.<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/114288#page/319/mode/1up Berg, Otto Karl. 1856.  Linnaea 27(3): 315] in Latin</ref><ref name=t>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40024277 Tropicos, ''Myrcianthes'' O. Berg ]</ref> They are native to [[Central America|Central]] and [[South America]], the [[West Indies]], and southern [[Florida]].<ref name=k>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=131717 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>
